headline: YEMEN 🏜️ FRONTLINE 🔥 DRONE 🛸 CHAOS as Houthis EDGE 💦 for CONTROL
text:
BBC 📰 crew just got the RARE 🍒 access to sneak into Yemen's SOUTHWESTERN 🏔️ conflict zone with those Saudi-backed 🐪 pro-government SOLDIERS 🪖 who are straight up getting RAILED 💦 by incoming DRONES 🛸 that buzz overhead like the world's horniest MOSQUITO 🦟!! This is the FIRST 🥇 drone the soldier 🫡 warned us before it usually leads to a full on ATTACK 🗡️ and sure enough the buzzing got LOUDER 📢 forcing everyone to dive under BUSHES 🌿 before scrambling back into the vehicle like they were edging the climax for ten whole MINUTES ⏰!! Then the loud THUDS 🔊 of strikes started dropping one after another though nobody could tell exactly where they were NUTTING 🥜 all over the mountains south-west of Taiz city!! It's impossible to even SPOT 🧐 where the front line officially BEGINS 🏁 in these rocky slopes bro the whole place is a no-man's-land built DIFFERENT 🏗️ with homes scattered like abandoned lovers 🏠💔 after families FLED 🏃‍♂️ the incoming Houthi SWEEP 💨 that just took a KEY 🔑 shipping chokepoint on the Red Sea coast escalating this civil WAR ⚔️ into absolute FREAKSHOW 🤪 levels!!

We rolled with the government FORCES 🛡️ from Taiz city through like thirty CHECKPOINTS 🛑 that scream how fractured these pro-gov troops really are before hitting the exact spot where their CONTROL 🕹️ ends and pure CHAOS 🌪️ no-man's-land BEGINS 🟥!! Homes dot the slopes but most stand EMPTY 🪑 after families dipped to dodge the nonstop MORTAR 🍆 fire and you can hear the eerie QUIET 🤫 broken only by bleating GOATS 🐐 and the constant crack of incoming and outgoing FIRE 🔥 that keeps everyone down BAD 😩!! Ali sat outside his crib with his herd of goats just ONE 🕐 kilometer from the front line and dropped that two mortars already LANDED 🛬 on his property yet he stayed to protect the ANIMALS 🐑 while shipping his kids off to a displacement CAMP ⛺ because they couldn't handle the shelling anymore!! "I am TERRIFIED 😱" he confessed but said he had no choice or they'd all go HUNGRY 🍽️ and die anyway without the livestock that literally FEEDS 🍼 their survival!! He only gave his first name because he's scared of REPERCUSSIONS 🪓 if the Houthis roll in and take over the zone in the coming DAYS 📅 while Houthi contacts are out here consolidating TROOPS 👥 prepping a major OFFENSIVE 🏹 and the government side claims they're AWARE 🧠 and getting ready to CLIMAX 💥 right back at them!!

At the closest CHECKPOINT 🚧 to the actual front line we linked up with fighters fresh off the mountain just a few hundred METERS 📏 from advancing Houthis and one admitted the bodies of EIGHTEEN 🔟🧮 government soldiers are just lying there in an area they can SHOOT 🔫 over but can't physically REACH 🖐️ to pull them out!! Fighting around Taiz has gotten absolutely COOKED 🔥 since the Houthis snatched the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha eighty five KILOMETERS 📍 west of the city on September TENTH 📆 after that four-year CEASEFIRE 🤝 completely unraveled like a cheap motel bedsheet!! These fighters took a massive swathe of territory overlooking the BAB 🍼 al-Mandab Strait which is that crucial shipping corridor linking Europe and Asia causing oil PRICES 💰 to spike hard from fears of more supply DISRUPTION 🚢!! Taiz is Yemen's third biggest CITY 🏙️ and its cultural CAPITAL 💎 home to nearly a million SOULS 👥 sitting at this vital intersection between Houthi north and government south while getting HEMMED 🪡 in by front lines from multiple DIRECTIONS 🧭!!

Government forces still hold the CENTER 🏛️ of Taiz but Houthi positions are pressing from the north east and especially the western APPROACHES 🛣️ where both sides are battling for high ground that overlooks the city's southern ROUTE 🛤️!! If Houthis secure those spots the government troops might find it way harder to ever RETAKE 🔄 Mokha and the whole situation is looking down BAD 🫠!! We rolled in from Aden in the south where the internationally recognised Presidential Leadership Council is based and counted about thirty CHECKPOINTS 🛑 along the way each run by different COMMANDERS 🧑‍✈️ showing how fractured this anti-Houthi side really is!! As we got closer the AMBULANCES 🚑 started flying past us we counted at least five in half an hour all rushing toward Taiz's main HOSPITAL 🏥 making it crystal clear we were driving straight into the throbbing HEART 💓 of a brutal BATTLE ⚔️!!

We pulled up after DARK 🌑 and the city was still VIBING 🎉 with shops lit up restaurants PACKED 🍛 and kids playing in the STREETS 🛣️ but every few minutes the THUD 🔊 of shelling and crack of gunfire from the surrounding mountains would rip through like an unwanted CREAMPIE 🥧 interrupting the whole scene!! Taiz has been a major battleground in this devastating civil WAR 🪖 ever since the Houthis ousted the government from Sanaa back in twenty fifteen and tried to snatch Taiz too but got driven out by local MILITIAMEN 🛡️!! Now in their latest OFFENSIVE 🏹 the Houthis are making heavy use of DRONES 🛸 alongside other weapons with Iran as their main supplier according to Saudi Arabia Western countries and UN EXPERTS 🧪 though Tehran denies sending actual WEAPONS 🔫 and claims it's only political SUPPORT 🤝!! There are persistent reports of Houthis recruiting CHILD 🧒 soldiers and one government fighter told us it's hard to look at a Yemeni kid and pull the TRIGGER 🔫 but when they're pointing the gun back at you you gotta DEFEND 🛡️ yourself!! The Houthis signed an action plan with the UN in twenty twenty two to end that practice but the BBC also spoke to teenagers serving with government FORCES 🪖 and the whole thing is just one giant unhinged cycle of TRAUMA 🩸!!

Meanwhile that Saudi-led COALITION 🤝 is backing the Yemeni government with weapons and has dropped hundreds of air strikes on Houthi positions along the Red Sea coast while the Houthis fire DRONES 🛸 and missiles right back at Saudi cities and infrastructure!! In the evening at al-Thawra hospital in Taiz the casualties from the front lines were pouring into the intensive care unit where every single BED 🛏️ was occupied with some patients fighters and others innocent CIVILIANS 👨‍👩‍👧!! Twelve-year-old Ghana Nabeel got seriously injured by a mortar while herding GOATS 🐐 when shrapnel smacked her head and her family said an incoming Houthi round landed nearby leaving her unconscious with her head wrapped in BANDAGES 🩹 face all swollen and BRUISED 🟣!! The doctor straight up said the injury damaged her brain and she will never be the SAME 🔄 again while the family waited at her bedside wondering what her life would look like if she even WAKES ⏰ up!! The UN reports one hundred thirty THOUSAND 💯🦘 people have been displaced by the fighting in Yemen this month alone and down at the al-Monig displacement camp about twenty kilometers south families from Mokha and hit villages were piling in among hundreds of TENTS ⛺ with two hundred families arriving in just the previous ten DAYS 📅!! Maryam Saleh not her real name rolled up a week earlier from Mokha with her husband and five kids the youngest only SEVEN 7️⃣ and she was weaving a hat to sell so she could buy FOOD 🥫 for the day after they walked barefoot carrying nothing but their CHILDREN 👨‍👩‍👧 while her nephew got killed by mortar shrapnel right behind her during the escape!! She described clashes and sniping both ahead and behind them seeing armed men on the mountain thinking they were FINISHED 🏁 with the kids screaming and crying but they kept pushing through the nightmare anyway!!
